articles.title: Big crypto wants the one thing it can’t buy: your vote
articles.description: Our loyalty has been to the technology. This election, the trap is to let the biggest intermediaries claim it for themselves, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

articles.title: Crypto investigators flag suspected $106M theft, $786K Solana bot drain
articles.description: A European entity may have lost $106 million from exchange accounts, while a wallet associated with a Solana arbitrage bot may have lost another $786,000.

articles.title: Coinbase hit with 50% price target cut as post-earnings rout deepens
articles.description: Slowing trading activity and fallout from the Binance hack are clouding Coinbase’s revenue prospects, prompting Morgan Stanley to lower its rating on the stock.

articles.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware
articles.description: German lawmakers and a filmmaker are among the people who received notifications from Apple warning that their phones may have been hacked.

articles.title: Bitcoin risks drop below $76K as 7% oil slide fails to spark BTC price rally
articles.description: Bitcoin fell around 1.7% on Monday as stocks pared early gains fueled by hopes of a diplomatic resolution to the US-Iran war.

articles.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
articles.description: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.

articles.title: Snap settles lawsuit accusing platform of fueling teen depression and eating disorders
articles.description: The plaintiffs said they started using YouTube as young as age 3 and other social media platforms at around age 9 and developed compulsive usage habits that they attributed to features such as autoplay and infinite scrolling.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin wallets show post-hack transfers after $46M theft
articles.description: Brazil’s exchange Mercado Bitcoin paused deposits and withdrawals after a security breach, saying customer funds and data were safe.

articles.title: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze
articles.description: Bulls are watching short positions, exchange withdrawals and key price levels for signs of a rebound after the midterms.

articles.title: Animoca Brands clears final hurdle for Abu Dhabi fund management
articles.description: The former mobile games company is building out its fund management business in Abu Dhabi as it targets institutional demand for stablecoins and tokenized assets.

articles.title: In one of the largest deals in tech history, Marvell buys Lumentum for $115B
articles.description: Marvell's planned purchase of Lumentum is one of the biggest acquisitions in tech history. And they both have the same strategic investor: Nvidia.

articles.title: Readwise takes on Amazon’s Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers
articles.description: Readwise Books combines an e-book store, reading tracker, detailed reading stats, and AI features in a bid to challenge Amazon's ecosystem.

articles.title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
articles.description: The unidentified attacker moved funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero, but the victim and affected exchanges remain unknown.

articles.title: NYSE tokenized stock plans take shape as four more transfer agents join
articles.description: Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate join the exchange's planned blockchain market, bringing shareholder records and voting services onchain.

articles.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
articles.description: Here's a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?

articles.title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
articles.description: Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having "the fastest growth of a product that I've ever seen in my life."

articles.title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains
articles.description: The Brazilian exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after wallets on at least 10 chains were emptied, days after the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

articles.title: Nvidia, Costco and Nike join pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.description: Nearly 70% of the companies initially picked for trading have opted out, while 19 firms including Apple, Tesla and Amazon have no disclosed objection as the 30-day response window nears its end.

articles.title: Anthropic swings to third quarter operating loss as compute costs surge ahead of IPO
articles.description: The Claude developer generated $17 billion in quarterly revenue, but higher computing costs resulted in a $567 million operating loss.

articles.title: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
articles.description: The bank uses Hong Kong's EnsembleTX system to move deposits between participating banks around the clock, settling in central bank money.
